limitations: STALE ANCHOR, stated not fixed: the fails_if threshold -0.0245 is the cited wall revenue_estimate.0q.growth, and that 0q is **Q2-2026** — CONFIRMED by its year-ago base matching MOPS Q2-2025 to 1.8e-5. Q2-2026 had already ENDED (2026-06-30) before the measured month (September 2026) began. The claim therefore tests a September monthly print against a consensus describing a quarter that closed three months earlier. The threshold is what it is and grades as written; a reader should know it is not a live consensus for the measured period.

WHY THE 0q POINTER DIFFERS FROM C8's: Yahoo's '0q' means the next UNREPORTED quarter at snapshot time. At the 2026-07-25 snapshot TSMC had already reported Q2-2026 (so its 0q was Q3-2026) while MediaTek had not (so its 0q was still Q2-2026). Two claims citing 'the same wall field class' are therefore citing different quarters. This is a property of the snapshot, discovered this session; see DEBT C30.
GRANULARITY: a monthly print graded against a quarterly consensus, as in C8.
